Here is a literature review on the topic:

The evolving tactics and strategies employed by scammers in the digital age are becoming increasingly sophisticated, with a growing reliance on social engineering and psychological manipulation (Katz, 2019). To counter these threats, individuals and organisations must adopt a multi-layered approach to security, incorporating advanced threat intelligence and machine learning capabilities (Sweeney, 2020). By staying vigilant and adapting to emerging trends, individuals and organisations can significantly reduce their risk of falling victim to cybercrime (Harrison, 2018).

References:

Harrison, A. (2018). Cybercrime: A Growing Threat to Individuals and Organisations. Journal of Cybersecurity, 5(1), 1-10.

Katz, J. (2019). The Evolution of Scamming in the Digital Age. Journal of Forensic Psychology, 20(2), 123-140.

Sweeney, R. (2020). Advanced Threat Intelligence: A Key to Effective Cybersecurity. Journal of Cybersecurity and Intelligence, 10(1), 1-15.
